title: Measure the gap between two shapes you drew
goal: The ruler can now measure a shape you drew, but only its width and height. Switch it to Gap and point at the space between two rectangles you made and nothing lights up: the whitespace reader still only sees the pixels of a screenshot, so the space between things you are building cannot be measured. Alignment checking has the same blind spot.
notes: Size mode was fixed on 2026-09-08 by adding PhotonzCore/LayerElements.swift (the document's own boxes as an element ladder) and merging it with ElementBounds in CanvasMeasure.refreshMeasureHoverReadout. Gap goes through ElementBounds.gap(at:in:) and alignment through AlignmentScan.items, both edge-map only, so both need the same treatment: a drawn-box source merged with the pixel one. Reuse LayerElements.candidates / .neighbors rather than adding a second walk of the layer tree.
acceptance: Pointing between two shapes you drew on a blank canvas shows the gap between them and clicking leaves that measurement
Gap over a screenshot still reads exactly as it does today
An alignment check drawn across shapes you drew counts them as items rather than reporting none
One walk under Scripts/playtest proves the drawn case and the screenshot case in the same run
